14/// A PDF document.
15///
16/// This can both be a combination of multiple incremental updates
17/// or just one (the last) incremental update in a PDF file.
18#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
19pub struct Document {
20    /// The version of the PDF specification to which the file conforms.
21    pub version: String,
22
23    /// The binary mark important for PDF A/2,3 tells various software tools to classify
24    /// the file as containing 8-bit binary that should be preserved during processing
25    pub binary_mark: Vec<u8>,
26
27    /// The trailer gives the location of the cross-reference table and of certain special objects.
28    pub trailer: Dictionary,
29
30    /// The cross-reference table contains locations of the indirect objects.
31    pub reference_table: Xref,
32
33    /// The objects that make up the document contained in the file.
34    pub objects: BTreeMap<ObjectId, Object>,
35
36    /// Current maximum object id within the document.
37    pub max_id: u32,
38
39    /// Current maximum object id within Bookmarks.
40    pub max_bookmark_id: u32,
41
42    /// The bookmarks in the document. Render at the very end of document after renumbering objects.
43    pub bookmarks: Vec<u32>,
44
45    /// used to locate a stored Bookmark so children can be appended to it via its id. Otherwise we
46    /// need to do recursive lookups and returns on the bookmarks internal layout Vec
47    pub bookmark_table: HashMap<u32, Bookmark>,
48
49    /// The byte the cross-reference table starts at.
50    /// This value is only set during reading, but not when writing the file.
51    /// It is used to support incremental updates in PDFs.
52    /// Default value is `0`.
53    pub xref_start: usize,
54
55    /// The encryption state stores the parameters that were used to decrypt this document if the
56    /// document has been decrypted.
57    pub encryption_state: Option<EncryptionState>,
58}

60impl Document {
61    /// Create new PDF document.
62    pub fn new() -> Self {
63        Self {
64            version: "1.4".to_string(),
65            binary_mark: vec![0xBB, 0xAD, 0xC0, 0xDE],
66            trailer: Dictionary::new(),
67            reference_table: Xref::new(0, XrefType::CrossReferenceStream),
68            objects: BTreeMap::new(),
69            max_id: 0,
70            max_bookmark_id: 0,
71            bookmarks: Vec::new(),
72            bookmark_table: HashMap::new(),
73            xref_start: 0,
74            encryption_state: None,
75        }
76    }
77
78    /// Create a new PDF document that is an incremental update to a previous document.
79    pub fn new_from_prev(prev: &Document) -> Self {
80        let mut new_trailer = prev.trailer.clone();
81        // A zero xref_start marks a document with no known on-disk table
82        // (e.g. recovered by scanning); emitting `/Prev 0` would corrupt the chain.
83        if prev.xref_start != 0 {
84            new_trailer.set("Prev", Object::Integer(prev.xref_start as i64));
85        }
86        Self {
87            version: "1.4".to_string(),
88            binary_mark: vec![0xBB, 0xAD, 0xC0, 0xDE],
89            trailer: new_trailer,
90            reference_table: Xref::new(0, prev.reference_table.cross_reference_type),
91            objects: BTreeMap::new(),
92            max_id: prev.max_id,
93            max_bookmark_id: prev.max_bookmark_id,
94            bookmarks: Vec::new(),
95            bookmark_table: HashMap::new(),
96            xref_start: 0,
97            encryption_state: None,
98        }
99    }
100
101    const DEREF_LIMIT: usize = 128;
102
103    fn recursive_fix_pages(&mut self, bookmarks: &[u32], first: bool) -> ObjectId {
104        if !bookmarks.is_empty() {
105            for id in bookmarks {
106                let (children, mut page) = match self.bookmark_table.get(id) {
107                    Some(n) => (n.children.clone(), n.page),
108                    None => return (0, 0),
109                };
110
111                if 0 == page.0 && !children.is_empty() {
112                    let objectid = self.recursive_fix_pages(&children[..], false);
113
114                    let bookmark = self.bookmark_table.get_mut(id).unwrap();
115                    bookmark.page = objectid;
116                    page = objectid;
117                }
118
119                if !first && 0 != page.0 {
120                    return page;
121                }
122
123                if first && !children.is_empty() {
124                    self.recursive_fix_pages(&children[..], first);
125                }
126            }
127        }
128
129        (0, 0)
130    }
131
132    /// Adjusts the Parents that have a ObjectId of (0,_) to that
133    /// of their first child. will recurse through all entries
134    /// till all parents of children are set. This should be
135    /// ran before building the final bookmark objects but after
136    /// renumbering of objects.
137    pub fn adjust_zero_pages(&mut self) {
138        self.recursive_fix_pages(&self.bookmarks.clone(), true);
139    }
140
141    /// Follow references if the supplied object is a reference.
142    ///
143    /// Returns a tuple of an optional object id and final object.
144    /// The object id will be None if the object was not a
145    /// reference. Otherwise, it will be the last object id in the
146    /// reference chain.
147    pub fn dereference<'a>(&'a self, mut object: &'a Object) -> Result<(Option<ObjectId>, &'a Object)> {
148        let mut nb_deref = 0;
149        let mut id = None;
150
151        while let Ok(ref_id) = object.as_reference() {
152            id = Some(ref_id);
153            object = self.objects.get(&ref_id).ok_or(Error::ObjectNotFound(ref_id))?;
154
155            nb_deref += 1;
156            if nb_deref > Self::DEREF_LIMIT {
157                return Err(Error::ReferenceLimit);
158            }
159        }
160
161        Ok((id, object))
162    }
163
164    /// Get object by object id, will iteratively dereference a referenced object.
165    pub fn get_object(&self, id: ObjectId) -> Result<&Object> {
166        let object = self.objects.get(&id).ok_or(Error::ObjectNotFound(id))?;
167        self.dereference(object).map(|(_, object)| object)
168    }
169
170    /// Determines if an object exists in the current document (or incremental update.)
171    /// with the given `ObjectId`.
172    /// `true` if the object exists, `false` if it does not exist.
173    pub fn has_object(&self, id: ObjectId) -> bool {
174        self.objects.contains_key(&id)
175    }
176
177    /// Get mutable reference to object by object ID, will iteratively dereference a referenced object.
178    pub fn get_object_mut(&mut self, id: ObjectId) -> Result<&mut Object> {
179        let object = self.objects.get(&id).ok_or(Error::ObjectNotFound(id))?;
180        let (ref_id, _obj) = self.dereference(object)?;
181
182        Ok(self.objects.get_mut(&ref_id.unwrap_or(id)).unwrap())
183    }
184
185    /// Get the object ID of the page that contains `id`.
186    pub fn get_object_page(&self, id: ObjectId) -> Result<ObjectId> {
187        for (_, object_id) in self.get_pages() {
188            let page = self.get_object(object_id)?.as_dict()?;
189            let annots = page.get(b"Annots")?.as_array()?;
190            let mut objects_ids = annots.iter().map(Object::as_reference);
191
192            let contains = objects_ids.any(|object_id| Some(id) == object_id.ok());
193            if contains {
194                return Ok(object_id);
195            }
196        }
197
198        Err(Error::PageNumberNotFound(0))
199    }

201    /// Get dictionary object by id.
202    pub fn get_dictionary(&self, id: ObjectId) -> Result<&Dictionary> {
203        self.get_object(id).and_then(Object::as_dict)
204    }

206    /// Get a mutable dictionary object by id.
207    pub fn get_dictionary_mut(&mut self, id: ObjectId) -> Result<&mut Dictionary> {
208        self.get_object_mut(id).and_then(Object::as_dict_mut)
209    }

211    /// Get dictionary in dictionary by key.
212    pub fn get_dict_in_dict<'a>(&'a self, node: &'a Dictionary, key: &[u8]) -> Result<&'a Dictionary> {
213        match node.get(key)? {
214            Object::Reference(object_id) => self.get_dictionary(*object_id),
215            Object::Dictionary(dic) => Ok(dic),
216            obj => Err(Error::ObjectType { expected: "Dictionary", found: obj.enum_variant() }),
217        }
218    }

220    /// Traverse objects from trailer recursively, return all referenced object IDs.
221    pub fn traverse_objects<A: Fn(&mut Object)>(&mut self, action: A) -> Vec<ObjectId> {
222        fn traverse_array<A: Fn(&mut Object)>(array: &mut [Object], action: &A, refs: &mut Vec<ObjectId>) {
223            for item in array.iter_mut() {
224                traverse_object(item, action, refs);
225            }
226        }
227        fn traverse_dictionary<A: Fn(&mut Object)>(dict: &mut Dictionary, action: &A, refs: &mut Vec<ObjectId>) {
228            for (_, v) in dict.iter_mut() {
229                traverse_object(v, action, refs);
230            }
231        }
232        fn traverse_object<A: Fn(&mut Object)>(object: &mut Object, action: &A, refs: &mut Vec<ObjectId>) {
233            action(object);
234            match object {
235                Object::Array(array) => traverse_array(array, action, refs),
236                Object::Dictionary(dict) => traverse_dictionary(dict, action, refs),
237                Object::Stream(stream) => traverse_dictionary(&mut stream.dict, action, refs),
238                Object::Reference(id) if !refs.contains(id) => {
239                    refs.push(*id);
240                }
241                _ => {}
242            }
243        }
244        let mut refs = vec![];
245        traverse_dictionary(&mut self.trailer, &action, &mut refs);
246        let mut index = 0;
247        while index < refs.len() {
248            if let Some(object) = self.objects.get_mut(&refs[index]) {
249                traverse_object(object, &action, &mut refs);
250            }
251            index += 1;
252        }
253        refs
254    }

256    /// Return dictionary with encryption information
257    pub fn get_encrypted(&self) -> Result<&Dictionary> {

259    }

271    /// Authenticate the provided owner password directly as bytes without sanitization
272    pub fn authenticate_raw_owner_password<P>(&self, password: P) -> Result<()>
273    where
274        P: AsRef<[u8]>,
275    {
276        if !self.is_encrypted() {
277            return Err(Error::NotEncrypted);
278        }
279
280        let password = password.as_ref();
281        let algorithm = PasswordAlgorithm::try_from(self)?;
282        algorithm.authenticate_owner_password(self, password)?;
283
284        Ok(())
285    }

358    /// Returns a `BTreeMap` of the crypt filters available in the PDF document if any.
359    pub fn get_crypt_filters(&self) -> BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Arc<dyn CryptFilter>> {
360        let mut crypt_filters = BTreeMap::new();
361
362        if let Ok(filters) = self.get_encrypted().and_then(|dict| dict.get(b"CF")).and_then(|object| object.as_dict()) {
363            for (name, filter) in filters {
364                let Ok(filter) = filter.as_dict() else {
365                    continue;
366                };
367
368                if filter.get(b"Type").is_ok() && !filter.has_type(b"CryptFilter") {
369                    continue;
370                }
371
372                // Get the Crypt Filter Method (CFM) used, if any, by the PDF reader to decrypt data.
373                let cfm = filter.get(b"CFM").and_then(|object| object.as_name()).ok();
374
375                let crypt_filter: Arc<dyn CryptFilter> = match cfm {
376                    // The application shall ask the security handler for the file encryption key
377                    // and shall implicitly decrypt data using the RC4 algorithm.
378                    Some(b"V2") => Arc::new(Rc4CryptFilter),
379                    // The application shall ask the security handler for the file encryption key
380                    // and shall implicitly decrypt data using the AES-128 algorithm in Cipher
381                    // Block Chaining (CBC) mode with a 16-byte block size and an initialization
382                    // vector that shall be randomly generated and placed as the first 16 bytes in
383                    // the stream or string. The key size (Length) shall be 128 bits.
384                    Some(b"AESV2") => Arc::new(Aes128CryptFilter),
385                    // The application shall ask the security handler for the file encryption key
386                    // and shall implicitly decrypt data using the AES-256 algorithm in Cipher
387                    // Block Chaining (CBC) with padding mode with a 16-byte block size and an
388                    // initialization vector that is randomly generated and placed as the first 16
389                    // bytes in the stream or string. The key size (Length) shall be 256 bits.
390                    Some(b"AESV3") => Arc::new(Aes256CryptFilter),
391                    // The application shall not decrypt data but shall direct the input stream to
392                    // the security handler for decryption.
393                    Some(b"Identity") | None => Arc::new(IdentityCryptFilter),
394                    // Unknown crypt filter method.
395                    _ => continue,
396                };
397
398                crypt_filters.insert(name.to_vec(), crypt_filter);
399            }
400        }
401
402        crypt_filters
403    }

405    /// Replaces all encrypted Strings and Streams with their encrypted contents
406    pub fn encrypt(&mut self, state: &EncryptionState) -> Result<()> {
407        if self.is_encrypted() {
408            return Err(Error::AlreadyEncrypted);
409        }
410
411        let encrypted = state.encode()?;
412
413        for (&id, obj) in self.objects.iter_mut() {
414            encryption::encrypt_object(state, id, obj)?;
415        }
416
417        let object_id = self.add_object(encrypted);
418        self.trailer.set(b"Encrypt", Object::Reference(object_id));
419        self.encryption_state = None;
420
421        Ok(())
422    }
423
424    /// Replaces all encrypted Strings and Streams with their decrypted contents
425    pub fn decrypt(&mut self, password: &str) -> Result<()> {
426        if !self.is_encrypted() {
427            return Err(Error::NotEncrypted);
428        }
429
430        let algorithm = PasswordAlgorithm::try_from(&*self)?;
431        let password = algorithm.sanitize_password(password)?;
432        self.decrypt_raw(&password)
433    }
434
435    /// Replaces all encrypted Strings and Streams with their decrypted contents with the password
436    /// provided directly as bytes without sanitization
437    pub fn decrypt_raw<P>(&mut self, password: P) -> Result<()>
438    where
439        P: AsRef<[u8]>,
440    {
441        if !self.is_encrypted() {
442            return Err(Error::NotEncrypted);
443        }
444
445        self.authenticate_raw_password(&password)?;
446
447        // Find the ID of the encryption dict; we'll want to skip it when decrypting
448        let encryption_obj_id = self.trailer.get(b"Encrypt").and_then(Object::as_reference)?;
449
450        let mut state = EncryptionState::decode(&*self, password)?;
451
452        for (&id, obj) in self.objects.iter_mut() {
453            // The encryption dictionary is not encrypted, leave it alone
454            if id == encryption_obj_id {
455                continue;
456            }
457
458            encryption::decrypt_object(&state, id, obj)?;
459        }
460
461        // Add the objects from the object streams now that they have been decrypted.
462        let mut object_streams = vec![];
463
464        for object in self.objects.values() {
465            let Ok(stream) = object.as_stream() else {
466                continue;
467            };
468
469            if !stream.dict.has_type(b"ObjStm") {
470                continue;
471            }
472
473            let Some(obj_stream) = ObjectStream::new(stream).ok() else {
474                continue;
475            };
476
477            // TODO: Is insert and replace intended behavior?
478            // See https://github.com/J-F-Liu/lopdf/issues/160 for more info
479            object_streams.extend(obj_stream.objects);
480        }
481
482        // Only add entries, but never replace entries
483        for (id, entry) in object_streams {
484            self.objects.entry(id).or_insert(entry);
485        }
486
487        let object_id = self.trailer.remove(b"Encrypt").unwrap().as_reference()?;
488        self.objects.remove(&object_id);
489
490        // Remember the object id of the original /Encrypt dictionary so that
491        // callers doing an incremental save can point the appended trailer's
492        // /Encrypt back at the (still-intact) dictionary bytes in the previous
493        // revision. See `IncrementalDocument::save_internal`.
494        state.encrypt_object_id = Some(object_id);
495
496        self.encryption_state = Some(state);
497
498        Ok(())
499    }

512    /// Get page numbers and corresponding object ids.
513    pub fn get_pages(&self) -> BTreeMap<u32, ObjectId> {
514        self.page_iter().enumerate().map(|(i, p)| ((i + 1) as u32, p)).collect()
515    }

517    pub fn page_iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = ObjectId> + '_ {
518        PageTreeIter::new(self)
519    }

521    /// Get content stream object ids of a page.
522    pub fn get_page_contents(&self, page_id: ObjectId) -> Vec<ObjectId> {
523        let mut streams = vec![];
524        if let Ok(page) = self.get_dictionary(page_id) {
525            let mut nb_deref = 0;
526            // Since we're looking for object IDs, we can't use get_deref
527            // so manually walk any references in contents object
528            if let Ok(mut contents) = page.get(b"Contents") {
529                loop {
530                    match contents {
531                        Object::Reference(id) => match self.objects.get(id) {
532                            None | Some(Object::Stream(_)) => {
533                                streams.push(*id);
534                            }
535                            Some(o) => {
536                                nb_deref += 1;
537                                if nb_deref < Self::DEREF_LIMIT {
538                                    contents = o;
539                                    continue;
540                                }
541                            }
542                        },
543                        Object::Array(arr) => {
544                            for content in arr {
545                                if let Ok(id) = content.as_reference() {
546                                    streams.push(id)
547                                }
548                            }
549                        }
550                        _ => {}
551                    }
552                    break;
553                }
554            }
555        }
556        streams
557    }
558
559    /// Add content to a page. All existing content will be unchanged.
560    pub fn add_page_contents(&mut self, page_id: ObjectId, content: Vec<u8>) -> Result<()> {
561        let page = self.get_dictionary(page_id)?;
562        let mut current_content_list: Vec<Object> = match page.get(b"Contents") {
563            Ok(Object::Reference(id)) => {
564                vec![Object::Reference(*id)]
565            }
566            Ok(Object::Array(arr)) => arr.clone(),
567            _ => vec![],
568        };
569        let content_object_id = self.add_object(Object::Stream(Stream::new(Dictionary::new(), content)));
570        current_content_list.push(Object::Reference(content_object_id));
571
572        let page_mut = self.get_object_mut(page_id).and_then(Object::as_dict_mut)?;
573        page_mut.set("Contents", current_content_list);
574        Ok(())
575    }
576
577    /// Get content of a page.
578    pub fn get_page_content(&self, page_id: ObjectId) -> Vec<u8> {
579        let mut content = Vec::new();
580        let content_streams = self.get_page_contents(page_id);
581        for object_id in content_streams {
582            if let Ok(content_stream) = self.get_object(object_id).and_then(Object::as_stream) {
583                match content_stream.decompressed_content() {
584                    Ok(data) => content.extend_from_slice(&data),
585                    Err(_) => content.extend_from_slice(&content_stream.content),
586                };
587                content.push(b'\n');
588            }
589        }
590        content
591    }
592
593    /// Get the content of a page, bounding the total decompressed output to
594    /// `max_decompressed_size` bytes.
595    ///
596    /// This is the decompression-bomb-safe counterpart to
597    /// [`Document::get_page_content`]. A page's content can be split across
598    /// several streams; the whole concatenated result is bounded to roughly
599    /// `max_decompressed_size` bytes (each stream is decoded against the
600    /// *remaining* budget, so N streams cannot sum to N times the limit), which
601    /// stops a small compressed page stream from inflating without limit when
602    /// processing untrusted PDFs. Use it (and
603    /// [`Document::extract_text_with_limit`]) instead of the unbounded variants
604    /// for input you do not control.
605    ///
606    /// Returns [`DecompressError::MemoryLimitExceeded`](crate::third_party::lopdf::DecompressError::MemoryLimitExceeded)
607    /// if the page content would exceed the limit. Like
608    /// [`Document::get_page_content`], a stream that fails to decode for a reason
609    /// *other* than the size limit falls back to its raw bytes, but that fallback
610    /// is also kept within the remaining budget.
611    pub fn get_page_content_with_limit(&self, page_id: ObjectId, max_decompressed_size: usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
612        let mut content = Vec::new();
613        let content_streams = self.get_page_contents(page_id);
614        for object_id in content_streams {
615            if let Ok(content_stream) = self.get_object(object_id).and_then(Object::as_stream) {
616                let remaining = max_decompressed_size.saturating_sub(content.len());
617                match content_stream.decompressed_content_with_limit(remaining) {
618                    Ok(data) => content.extend_from_slice(&data),
619                    Err(Error::Decompress(DecompressError::MemoryLimitExceeded { .. })) => {
620                        return Err(DecompressError::MemoryLimitExceeded { limit: max_decompressed_size }.into());
621                    }
622                    // Mirror `get_page_content`'s lenient fallback to the raw
623                    // (still-compressed) bytes when a stream can't be decoded, but
624                    // keep that fallback within the page's remaining budget so a
625                    // large raw stream can't bypass the guard.
626                    Err(_) => {
627                        if content_stream.content.len() > remaining {
628                            return Err(DecompressError::MemoryLimitExceeded { limit: max_decompressed_size }.into());
629                        }
630                        content.extend_from_slice(&content_stream.content);
631                    }
632                }
633                content.push(b'\n');
634            }
635        }
636        Ok(content)
637    }
638
639    /// Get resources used by a page.
640    pub fn get_page_resources(&self, page_id: ObjectId) -> Result<(Option<&Dictionary>, Vec<ObjectId>)> {
641        fn collect_resources(
642            page_node: &Dictionary,
643            resource_ids: &mut Vec<ObjectId>,
644            doc: &Document,
645            already_seen: &mut HashSet<ObjectId>,
646        ) -> Result<()> {
647            if let Ok(resource_id) = page_node.get(b"Resources").and_then(Object::as_reference) {
648                resource_ids.push(resource_id);
649            }
650            if let Ok(parent_id) = page_node.get(b"Parent").and_then(Object::as_reference) {
651                if already_seen.contains(&parent_id) {
652                    return Err(Error::ReferenceCycle(parent_id));
653                }
654                if already_seen.len() >= crate::third_party::lopdf::reader::MAX_NESTING_DEPTH {
655                    return Err(Error::RecursionLimit);
656                }
657                already_seen.insert(parent_id);
658                let parent_dict = doc.get_dictionary(parent_id)?;
659                collect_resources(parent_dict, resource_ids, doc, already_seen)?;
660            }
661            Ok(())
662        }
663
664        let mut resource_dict = None;
665        let mut resource_ids = Vec::new();
666        if let Ok(page) = self.get_dictionary(page_id) {
667            resource_dict = page.get(b"Resources").and_then(Object::as_dict).ok();
668            collect_resources(page, &mut resource_ids, self, &mut HashSet::new())?;
669        }
670        Ok((resource_dict, resource_ids))
671    }
672
673    /// Get fonts used by a page.
674    pub fn get_page_fonts(&self, page_id: ObjectId) -> Result<BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, &Dictionary>> {
675        fn collect_fonts_from_resources<'a>(resources: &'a Dictionary, fonts: &mut BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, &'a Dictionary>, doc: &'a Document) {
676            if let Ok(font) = resources.get(b"Font") {
677                let font_dict = match font {
678                    Object::Reference(id) => doc.get_object(*id).and_then(Object::as_dict).ok(),
679                    Object::Dictionary(dict) => Some(dict),
680                    _ => None,
681                };
682                if let Some(font_dict) = font_dict {
683                    for (name, value) in font_dict.iter() {
684                        let font = match value {
685                            Object::Reference(id) => doc.get_dictionary(*id).ok(),
686                            Object::Dictionary(dict) => Some(dict),
687                            _ => None,
688                        };
689                        if !fonts.contains_key(name) {
690                            font.map(|font| fonts.insert(name.clone(), font));
691                        }
692                    }
693                }
694            }
695        }
696
697        let mut fonts = BTreeMap::new();
698        let (resource_dict, resource_ids) = self.get_page_resources(page_id)?;
699        if let Some(resources) = resource_dict {
700            collect_fonts_from_resources(resources, &mut fonts, self);
701        }
702        for resource_id in resource_ids {
703            if let Ok(resources) = self.get_dictionary(resource_id) {
704                collect_fonts_from_resources(resources, &mut fonts, self);
705            }
706        }
707        Ok(fonts)
708    }
709
710    /// Get the PDF annotations of a page. The /Subtype of each annotation dictionary defines the
711    /// annotation type (Text, Link, Highlight, Underline, Ink, Popup, Widget, etc.). The /Rect of
712    /// an annotation dictionary defines its location on the page.
713    ///
714    /// `/Annots` itself may be an array or a reference to one, and each entry of that array may be
715    /// a reference to an annotation dictionary or, equally legally, the dictionary written directly
716    /// (ISO 32000-1, 12.5.2 requires an indirect object only for an annotation that carries a
717    /// `/Popup` or is the target of an `/IRT` reply). Both forms are returned.
718    ///
719    /// An entry that is neither is skipped, as is a reference that does not resolve to a
720    /// dictionary: a damaged entry costs its own annotation rather than the whole page.
721    pub fn get_page_annotations(&self, page_id: ObjectId) -> Result<Vec<&Dictionary>> {
722        let Ok(page) = self.get_dictionary(page_id) else {
723            return Ok(vec![]);
724        };
725        let entries = match page.get(b"Annots") {
726            Ok(Object::Reference(id)) => self.get_object(*id).and_then(Object::as_array)?,
727            Ok(Object::Array(entries)) => entries,
728            _ => return Ok(vec![]),
729        };
730        let mut annotations = Vec::with_capacity(entries.len());
731        for entry in entries {
732            match entry {
733                Object::Reference(id) => {
734                    if let Ok(dictionary) = self.get_dictionary(*id) {
735                        annotations.push(dictionary);
736                    }
737                }
738                Object::Dictionary(dictionary) => annotations.push(dictionary),
739                _ => {}
740            }
741        }
742        Ok(annotations)
743    }
744
745    pub fn get_page_images(&'_ self, page_id: ObjectId) -> Result<Vec<PdfImage<'_>>> {
746        let mut images = vec![];
747        if let Ok(page) = self.get_dictionary(page_id) {
748            let resources = self.get_dict_in_dict(page, b"Resources")?;
749            let xobject = match self.get_dict_in_dict(resources, b"XObject") {
750                Ok(xobject) => xobject,
751                Err(err) => match err {
752                    // XObject is optional, no images found
753                    Error::DictKey(_) => return Ok(Vec::default()),
754                    _ => Err(err)?,
755                },
756            };
757
758            for (_, xvalue) in xobject.iter() {
759                let id = xvalue.as_reference()?;
760                let xvalue = self.get_object(id)?;
761                let xvalue = xvalue.as_stream()?;
762                let dict = &xvalue.dict;
763                if dict.get(b"Subtype")?.as_name()? != b"Image" {
764                    continue;
765                }
766                let width = dict.get(b"Width")?.as_i64()?;
767                let height = dict.get(b"Height")?.as_i64()?;
768                let color_space = match dict.get(b"ColorSpace") {
769                    Ok(cs) => match cs {
770                        Object::Array(array) => match array.first() {
771                            Some(first) => Some(String::from_utf8_lossy(first.as_name()?).to_string()),
772                            None => None,
773                        },
774                        Object::Name(name) => Some(String::from_utf8_lossy(name).to_string()),
775                        _ => None,
776                    },
777                    Err(_) => None,
778                };
779                let bits_per_component = match dict.get(b"BitsPerComponent") {
780                    Ok(bpc) => Some(bpc.as_i64()?),
781                    Err(_) => None,
782                };
783                let mut filters = vec![];
784                if let Ok(filter) = dict.get(b"Filter") {
785                    match filter {
786                        Object::Array(array) => {
787                            for obj in array.iter() {
788                                let name = obj.as_name()?;
789                                filters.push(String::from_utf8_lossy(name).to_string());
790                            }
791                        }
792                        Object::Name(name) => {
793                            filters.push(String::from_utf8_lossy(name).to_string());
794                        }
795                        _ => {}
796                    }
797                };
798
799                images.push(PdfImage {
800                    id,
801                    width,
802                    height,
803                    color_space,
804                    bits_per_component,
805                    filters: Some(filters),
806                    content: &xvalue.content,
807                    origin_dict: &xvalue.dict,
808                });
809            }
810        }
811        Ok(images)
812    }

814    pub fn decode_text(encoding: &Encoding, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<String> {
815        debug!("Decoding text with {encoding:#?}");
816        encoding.bytes_to_string(bytes)
817    }
818
819    pub fn encode_text(encoding: &Encoding, text: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
820        encoding.string_to_bytes(text)
821    }
822}

824impl Default for Document {
825    fn default() -> Self {
826        Self::new()
827    }
828}
829
830struct PageTreeIter<'a> {
831    doc: &'a Document,
832    stack: Vec<&'a [Object]>,
833    kids: Option<&'a [Object]>,
834    iter_limit: usize,
835}
836
837impl<'a> PageTreeIter<'a> {
838    const PAGE_TREE_DEPTH_LIMIT: usize = 256;
839
840    fn new(doc: &'a Document) -> Self {
841        if let Ok(page_tree_id) = doc.catalog().and_then(|cat| cat.get(b"Pages")).and_then(Object::as_reference) {
842            Self { doc, kids: Self::kids(doc, page_tree_id), stack: Vec::with_capacity(32), iter_limit: doc.objects.len() }
843        } else {
844            Self { doc, kids: None, stack: Vec::new(), iter_limit: doc.objects.len() }
845        }
846    }
847
848    fn kids(doc: &Document, page_tree_id: ObjectId) -> Option<&[Object]> {
849        doc.get_dictionary(page_tree_id).and_then(|page_tree| page_tree.get_deref(b"Kids", doc)).and_then(Object::as_array).map(|k| k.as_slice()).ok()
850    }
851}
852
853impl Iterator for PageTreeIter<'_> {
854    type Item = ObjectId;
855
856    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
857        loop {
858            while let Some((kid, new_kids)) = self.kids.and_then(|k| k.split_first()) {
859                if self.iter_limit == 0 {
860                    return None;
861                }
862                self.iter_limit -= 1;
863
864                self.kids = Some(new_kids);
865
866                if let Ok(kid_id) = kid.as_reference()
867                    && let Ok(type_name) = self.doc.get_dictionary(kid_id).and_then(Dictionary::get_type)
868                {
869                    match type_name {
870                        b"Page" => {
871                            return Some(kid_id);
872                        }
873                        b"Pages" if self.stack.len() < Self::PAGE_TREE_DEPTH_LIMIT => {
874                            let kids = self.kids.unwrap();
875                            if !kids.is_empty() {
876                                self.stack.push(kids);
877                            }
878                            self.kids = Self::kids(self.doc, kid_id);
879                        }
880                        b"Pages" => {}
881                        _ => {}
882                    }
883                }
884            }
885
886            // Current level exhausted, try to pop.
887            if let kids @ Some(_) = self.stack.pop() {
888                self.kids = kids;
889            } else {
890                return None;
891            }
892        }
893    }
894
895    fn size_hint(&self) -> (usize, Option<usize>) {
896        let kids = self.kids.unwrap_or(&[]);
897
898        let nb_pages: usize = kids
899            .iter()
900            .chain(self.stack.iter().flat_map(|k| k.iter()))
901            .map(|kid| {
902                if let Ok(dict) = kid.as_reference().and_then(|id| self.doc.get_dictionary(id)) {
903                    if let Ok(b"Pages") = dict.get_type() {
904                        let count = dict.get_deref(b"Count", self.doc).and_then(Object::as_i64).unwrap_or(0);
905                        // Don't let page count go backwards in case of an invalid document.
906                        max(0, count) as usize
907                    } else {
908                        1
909                    }
910                } else {
911                    1
912                }
913            })
914            .sum();
915
916        (nb_pages, Some(nb_pages))
917    }
918}
919
920impl std::iter::FusedIterator for PageTreeIter<'_> {}
